title: Juice N Power Starfruit Kiwi Power 100ml Shortfill E-liquid
description: Starfruit Kiwi Power from Juice N Power is an irresistibly exotic blend of two tropical fruits that tastes of far-flung holidays. The rich, smooth sweetness of star fruit blends perfectly with the luscious tang of kiwi to create a sumptuously tasty vaping experience. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks.
